name: At glance
description:
1. **Request** — In the solopreneur home, the "At a glance" block had to fit a single row on mobile, smaller and with icons.
2. **Investigation** — Changes belong in `SolopreneurSummary.vue` (auto-fit grid, `p-5` cards + progress bar), `useSolopreneur.js` (measured-width viewport tiers `isWide`/`isXl`, no phone tier), and `i18n.js` (long `gl.*` labels).
3. **Approach** — Added a measured `isCompact` tier (`width < 640`) instead of media/container queries, so it also covers narrow dockview panels.
4. **Implementation** — Compact variant: `grid-cols-4`, section `p-3`, icon + small value + 2-line short label, progress bars dropped; regular layout left byte-for-byte unchanged.
5. **Changes** — 3 files updated: compact rendering in `SolopreneurSummary.vue`, new `isCompact` tier in `useSolopreneur.js`, and `gl.*Short` labels (EN/ES/FR) in `i18n.js`.
